en.tagline: Run cloud AI apps for images, video, LLMs and search
en.summary: infsh-cli is a command-line tool for running hosted AI apps on inference.sh. It covers image and video generation, LLM calls, web search, 3D generation and Twitter/X actions, all through the `belt` command. The apps run in the cloud, so no local GPU is needed.
problem: Running generative models such as image, video or LLM models usually means local GPU hardware or a separate API for each provider. Your scripts and agents then need a different integration for each one.
With this skill, an agent or script calls every listed app through the same `belt app run` command. Local files can be passed by path and are uploaded automatically.
fit: Generating images or video without a local GPU
Calling Claude, Gemini or other LLMs from a script or agent
Adding web search (Tavily, Exa) or Twitter/X actions to an agent workflow
unfit: Needing a model that is not in the inference.sh app store
Wanting a graphical interface instead of a command line
steps: Log in with `belt login`, or set `INFERENCE_API_KEY` in non-interactive shells.
Find an app with `belt app search "flux"` or `belt app list --category image`.
Check the app's inputs with `belt app get <app>` and create a sample input file with `belt app sample <app> --save input.json`.
Run the app with `belt app run <app> --input input.json`. Local file paths in the input are uploaded automatically.
For long jobs, add `--no-wait` to return right away, then check progress with `belt task get <task-id>`.

zh.tagline: 命令行运行云端AI应用，覆盖图像、视频、大模型与搜索
zh.summary: infsh-cli 是一个命令行工具，用于运行 inference.sh 上托管的 AI 应用。它通过 `belt` 命令提供图像和视频生成、大模型调用、网页搜索、3D 生成以及 Twitter/X 操作。应用在云端运行，不需要本地 GPU。
problem: 生成图像、视频或调用大模型通常需要本地 GPU，或者为每个服务商单独接入 API。脚本和智能体因此要为每个模型写不同的对接代码。
使用这个技能后，智能体或脚本可以通过同一条 `belt app run` 命令调用所有列出的应用。本地文件可以直接传路径，CLI 会自动上传。
fit: 没有本地 GPU，需要生成图像或视频
在脚本或智能体中调用 Claude、Gemini 等大模型
为智能体流程加入网页搜索（Tavily、Exa）或 Twitter/X 操作
unfit: 需要的模型不在 inference.sh 应用商店中
希望使用图形界面而不是命令行
steps: 运行 `belt login` 登录，或在非交互式 shell 中设置 `INFERENCE_API_KEY`。
用 `belt app search "flux"` 或 `belt app list --category image` 查找应用。
用 `belt app get <app>` 查看应用的输入参数，并用 `belt app sample <app> --save input.json` 生成示例输入文件。
用 `belt app run <app> --input input.json` 运行应用。输入中的本地文件路径会被自动上传。
对于耗时较长的任务，加上 `--no-wait` 立即返回，再用 `belt task get <task-id>` 查看进度。
